case.t0_rule: WHO declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (docs/DAC_PPE_CODING.md §2)
case.response_scale: EU institutions (Commission); member-state acts are context, except acts against the EU response (counter_measure)
case.start_rule: First purchase contract for PPE signed by the EU institutions for general supply; tenders (joint procurement) and purchases by rescEU host member states excluded

inclusion_rules.firm_order: First purchase contract for PPE signed by the EU institutions
inclusion_rules.binding_act: First legally binding EU act concerning the PPE response
inclusion_rules.dedicated_funding: First funding legally earmarked for PPE
inclusion_rules.delivery: First physical delivery of EU-procured or EU-financed PPE to member states
inclusion_rules.counter_measure: Member-state act against the EU response (e.g. export ban)
inclusion_rules.institutionalisation: First permanent body created for the hazard

observation_window.reason: First wave; opens 1 Jan so that pre-t0 events can be context (docs/DAC_PPE_CODING.md §5)

events.description: WHO declares a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (not in the EU sources; cited from the Belgian chronology, rule §5 Germany a)
events.source: Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 342, row 36 (CRIV K001, De Raedt)
Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 363, row 51 (CRIV K001, De Raedt)

events.description: Start of the EU Joint Procurement communicated (as recorded in the Belgian chronology)
events.source: Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 346, row 761 (written answers, SPF Santé publique)

events.description: First EU joint-procurement tender for PPE (a tender, not a firm order; rule §5 EU a); dated 27 Feb (row 360) or 28 Feb (row 44), rows cross-flagged 'Contradict.'; also 'has been launched' per recital 3 of Regulation 2020/402
events.source: Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 353, row 360 (Nève & Péters, CSS) and PDF p. 354, row 44 (CRIV K001, De Raedt); Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2020/402 of 14 March 2020, OJ L 77 I, 15.3.2020, PDF p. 1, recital 3
events.source_wording: 'la Belgique participe à un achat groupé au niveau européen (Joint Procurement EPI)' (27/02/2020, row 360); 'Premier joint procurement EPI' (28/02/2020, row 44)

events.description: German order restricting foreign trade in medical protective equipment (ban on export and shipment), notified to the Commission; works against the EU single-market response (rule §5 EU e)
events.source: European Commission, TRIS notification 2020/0104/D (Germany), date received 04/03/2020, PDF p. 1 (data/sources/dac_ppe/DE_tris_2020-0104-D.pdf); also Chambre, Commission spéciale COVID-19, DOC 55 1394/002 (2021), Annexe 5, PDF p. 358, row 1031 (CRIV K038-2, Geens)

events.description: Commission makes the export of PPE outside the Union subject to an export authorisation; adopted 14 March, in force on publication 15 March for six weeks (rule §5 EU b)
events.source: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2020/402 of 14 March 2020, OJ L 77 I, 15.3.2020, PDF p. 2 (Art. 1) and p. 3 (Art. 3, date of adoption)

events.description: Commission adds medical stockpiling, including PPE, to the rescEU capacities and sets the cost categories for Union financial assistance (no amount; a new capacity, not a new body; rules §5 EU c, f)
events.source: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/414 of 19 March 2020, OJ L 82 I, 19.3.2020, PDF p. 1 (date), p. 2 (recital 11) and p. 3 (Art. 3c)

events.description: Amending budget No 1/2020 adopted: +EUR 70 million commitments to line 23 03 01 01 (civil-protection preparedness; remarks do not name PPE, rule §5 EU h)
events.source: Definitive adoption (EU, Euratom) 2020/536 of Amending budget No 1 of the EU for 2020, OJ L 126, 21.4.2020, PDF p. 1 (adoption) and p. 49 (line 23 03 01 01)

events.description: Amending budget No 2/2020 adopted: +EUR 300 million commitments to line 23 03 01 01 (civil-protection preparedness; remarks do not name PPE, rule §5 EU h)
events.source: Definitive adoption (EU, Euratom) 2020/537 of Amending budget No 2 of the EU for 2020, OJ L 126, 21.4.2020, PDF p. 1 (adoption) and p. 28 (line 23 03 01 01)

events.description: First delivery of masks from the rescEU reserve, to Italy, Spain and Croatia (rule §5 EU d); EP photo record: FFP2 masks from the rescEU reserve (hosted by Romania) delivered to Milan
events.source: Sénat, rapport no. 199 (2020-2021), tome I, PDF p. 400; European Parliament Multimedia Centre, photo record P-043686, 'Coronavirus - Delivery of medical equipment from RescEU Reserve in Italy' (data/sources/dac_ppe/EU_ep_photo_P043686.txt), p. 1

events.description: No purchase contract signed by the EU institutions documented in the window; joint-procurement tenders are context and rescEU stock is bought by host member states (Sénat p. 400; rule §5 EU a)
events.source: Regulation 2020/402, Decision 2020/414, Sénat rapport no. 199 p. 400, Belgian Annex 5: searched in full

events.description: Commission covers 100% of the rescEU stock's costs (Sénat p. 400) but no source dates the commitment; Decision 2020/414 sets cost categories without an amount (rule §5 EU c); Amending budgets 1 and 2/2020 add funds to a general civil-protection line whose remarks do not name PPE (rule §5 EU h)
events.source: Decision 2020/414, Sénat rapport no. 199 p. 400, Amending budgets 1 and 2/2020 (line 23 03 01 01 remarks): searched in full

events.description: No permanent body for the hazard created in the window (rescEU medical stockpiling is a new capacity of an existing reserve; rule §5 EU f)

ECDC's first risk assessment on the hazard: Threat Assessment Brief 'Pneumonia cases possibly associated with a novel coronavirus in Wuhan, China', dated 9 January 2020 on the document and its publication page. Early-warning alternative t0 (docs/DAC_T0_EARLY_WARNING.md)
events.source: ECDC, Threat Assessment Brief, 9 January 2020, PDF p. 1 (data/sources/dac_t0/ecdc_2020-01-09_tab_ncov.txt, sha256 2963d5b9...)
